title: Trump orders DOJ to investigate Democrats for 'threatening' people
detail: Al Jazeera reports Trump directed the Department of Justice to investigate Democrats over alleged threats against people. Details of the order and the specific allegations were not independently verified.

media.caption: Trump orders DOJ to investigate Democrats

confidenceReason: Single outlet report; order text not verified.

title: Trump reportedly offers White House press secretary role to UFC chief Dana White
detail: Le Monde and Clarín report Trump approached UFC president Dana White about becoming White House press secretary. Not confirmed by the White House.
confidenceReason: Reported by two outlets, likely same origin; no official confirmation.
